outcome: postoperative scar healing (assessed by Manchester, POSAS, Vancouver, VAS, NRS, REEDA scales)
hematological parameters (hemoglobin, hematocrit, leukocyte count, platelet count)
cohort: The study included 50 patients undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Intraoperative PRP administration significantly enhanced postoperative scar healing after cesarean delivery and was associated with reduced inflammation and improved hematological recovery.
mod_finding: Intraoperative PRP application improved scar healing specifically after cesarean section.
